thread:
Dana: Tiny but huge shoutout to Omar and Lina 1 for swooping in on the surprise partner demo and ironing out the embed alignment issue. Saved the day! :sparkles: :clap:
Omar: was a weird tokenization mismatch between the client and our SDK. quick patch to normalize unicode and the previews looked correct. :ok_hand:
Lina: added a guard in the serializer so future uploads won't trigger the mismatch. dropping the snippet here:
```
# normalize text before embed
text = unicodedata.normalize('NFC', raw_text)
text = text.replace('\u200b', '')
```
Dana: legends. partner said the demo "felt polished" afterwards. sending virtual cupcakes. :cupcake:
kudos-bot: Posted kudos: "Omar & Lina - Partner demo save" (https://kudos.redwood/entry/4521)
people-ops: Sending a small snack stipend to Omar & Lina. Check your inbox for the voucher. :tada:
Omar: thanks team! also huge props to Dana for coordinating the quick rollback plan.
Lina: appreciated. i'll PR the serializer change and add a short note to the integration guide under "text normalization".
Dana: can someone drop a 1-line blurb for the post-demo notes so I can send to the partner?
Omar: "Fixed unicode normalization bug in SDK serializer to ensure consistent embeddings across platforms."
Dana: perfect. closing thread with thanks again. you two rock. :heart:
